issues.description: The problem statement UML and text specify numberOfTutors as an int, but the solution implementation declares numberOfTutors as a short (and uses a short-typed constructor/setter). This type mismatch between the specification and the provided solution can confuse students about the expected type and lead to inconsistent implementations or test expectations.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the types across artifacts. Either change the solution implementation to declare numberOfTutors as an int (update the field, constructor parameter, and setter to use int) so it matches the UML/problem statement, or update the UML/problem statement to explicitly state short if that was intended. Prefer updating the solution to use int to match the specification and avoid surprising students.
